blockingIssues.description: The feature is marked as fulfilling VAL-UI-003 even though commit 89b3d3a only added a placeholder assistant route; the actual chat-screen wiring arrived later in ui-chat-screen-core, so the feature overclaims its validation coverage.
startNewConversation() clears state and sets conversationId to null but does not create or reserve a new conversation ID, violating VAL-UI-004's New Chat contract.

Conversation restoration is truncated to the latest 20 turns because loadRecentMessages() hard-caps history and loadConversation() does not override it, violating VAL-UI-006's full-history requirement.

ChatScreen invokes useAssistant without passing active farm context and the no-farm banner only checks whether the user has zero farms, so farm-specific guidance and selected-farm routing are missing.
Retry does not resend the same payload for failed image requests because sendMessage() clears attachments immediately and retryLastMessage() only replays the last text message.

The assistant backend path still reduces image attachments to the text placeholder 'image attached by user', so the model never receives actual image content and cannot satisfy VAL-UI-026's image-aware response requirement.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated .factory/library/architecture.md with assistant-specific notes covering selected-farm context preservation, multimodal attachment forwarding requirements, and the Expo Router NativeTabs headerRight typing workaround.
Captured in .factory/library/architecture.md that meaningful image responses require multimodal forwarding and that no-farm handling must distinguish between 'no farms' and 'no active farm selected'.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: When authoring mission features, only assign a validation assertion to the feature that actually implements the user-visible behavior. Placeholder or scaffolding features should not claim downstream assertions that are completed by later wiring work.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: ui-tab-navigation allows a placeholder assistant screen in its description but was still marked as fulfilling VAL-UI-003, while ui-chat-screen-core is the feature that actually wires ChatScreen into app/(tabs)/assistant.tsx.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify the TDD guidance for lightweight navigation/i18n tasks: require a minimal render/navigation smoke test, but do not present strict test-first sequencing as mandatory when the work is mostly route wiring or translation plumbing.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The ui-tab-navigation worker implemented the route/layout changes before adding tests and explicitly requested that the skill be relaxed for this class of task.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: For assistant-screen migrations, instruct workers to compare the redesigned flow against any surviving legacy assistant route before deleting or bypassing it so farm-context handling, attachment semantics, and other behavioral requirements are preserved.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: ui-citations-errors-confirmations dropped active-farm routing and image attachment behavior that were still present in app/ai-chat.tsx, and the reviewer found the gap only by comparing the new screen against the legacy flow.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the repo-specific `react-hooks/refs` lint suppression pattern for Animated.Value refs passed directly through JSX style props, so workers know when a targeted suppression is acceptable.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: ui-conversation-sidebar introduced `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/refs` comments for Animated.Value refs in ConversationSidebar.tsx, and the worker handoff requested that this lint rule behavior be captured in the skill guidance.
